summary: Verified the 'two parallel horizontal lines' bug fix on the 'Jaipur Is Rising' sticky-scroll section. Sampled multiple scroll fractions (0.4, 0.7, 0.9) on Desktop 1920x1080 and 0.7 on Mobile 390x844. At every sampled fraction the gaps between skyline bars are pure black — no full-width horizontal line or tonal band crossing the gaps. Tiered top edges are present only within each bar's own width, which is the intended design. Regression checks passed: three rows of bars remain visible through the sequence, 'SO ARE WE' headline appears mid-scroll, the TierMark logo appears near the end (frac >=0.7), and after the 380vh section the page transitions smoothly into the next 'VISION' philosophy section with no giant empty black gap. Bars do NOT fly off-screen early (the reverted padding-based bug did not regress). Bug fix (boxShadow 0 150vh 0 <same rgba> per bar) is effective.
critical_code_review_comments: JaipurRising.jsx duplicates the Row pattern inline for the FRONT bar (lines 79-85) instead of reusing the <Row> component. Minor DRY improvement possible: pass an extra opacity prop to Row and use it for FRONT.

boxShadow '0 150vh 0 0 rgba(...)' is a clever mask but could cause slight paint-cost on low-end devices; consider clipping the sticky container with an explicit bottom color or using a solid bg pseudo-element beneath the rows for future maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home has an intro overlay + cookie banner; when testing scroll animations, click 'SKIP INTRO' then 'ACCEPT' cookies before scrolling. Section height=380vh, scroll_range = section.offsetHeight - vh. Use window.scrollTo(0, section_top + scroll_range * frac) to sample any animation fraction deterministically. data-testid='jaipur-rising' identifies the section.
rca of the issue: Original bug: the three bar rows (bg-white/5, /9, /14) translate upward by different amounts inside a sticky 100vh container. When a row lifts, the bottom edge of the row's translucent color becomes visible as a full-width horizontal tonal band crossing both bars and gaps. Applied fix (verified): each bar carries a downward box-shadow (0 150vh 0 0 <same rgba as its row>) so the bar's color continues far below the viewport — the bottom edge never enters view, and because the shadow is per-bar (flex item width), it does NOT span the gaps. Layout, heights, and scroll-driven translate values are byte-identical to before, so the animation timing/behavior is unchanged.
